criteria.requirement: Report actual model-driven approved-tool integration outcomes without claiming legal quality or improvement.
criteria.pass: Every claimed outcome is supported by the retained native trajectory and actual owned resources; unresolved gaps remain explicit.
criteria.fail: Catalogue entries, operator probes or fabricated observations are represented as native tool execution.
criteria.minimalPass: An independently verified infrastructure coverage matrix; no legal comparison score.
criteria.nearMiss: A model-authored coverage report without independent invocation or observation evidence.
